dedupe_keys.name: indicateurs de condition des chaussees du reseau cyclable

description: Indicateurs de condition des chaussées du réseau cyclable is a dataset listed in City of Montréal open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. La Ville de Montréal est responsable du développement, de l’entretien et de la gestion du réseau des voies cyclables situé sur son territoire. La connaissance de la condition de l’état de ce réseau est un élément important du processus de gestion, de détermination des besoins et d’établissement d’un niveau de service adéquat pour les usagers. Coverage: Montréal. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are PoleARTM, SIRR, condition des chaussées, indicateur de performance, piste cyclable. It offers 2 resource(s) in GPKG. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-montreal-portal.
